name: krabi-flight-radar
description: Personal flight intelligence engine: best total journey from Alphen aan den Rijn to Krabi.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/server
